title: Project Zero intake submission v1.0
description: How leads enter Deal Flow. EXTERNAL callers (Grok via `pz intake submit <file>`, the operator's paste via POST /api/intake/submissions) send this envelope and may assert only origin 'grok' or 'manual'. TRUSTED in-process callers (registry connectors, research jobs, the legacy importer) never use this envelope: they call the intake service directly with a server-set origin, but every entity they pass is validated against the same `#/$defs/entity`. A submission that fails validation writes nothing and returns the exact reasons. The same submission twice (sha256 of its canonical JSON) is a no-op. Submitting never decides anything. Validators MUST enable format assertion (Draft 2020-12 FormatChecker).

origin.description: Only the origins an external caller may assert. registry_scan / research / legacy_* are server-side only.

external_ref.description: Submitter's own id for this delivery, e.g. a Grok cycle id 'MW-2026-11-12' or '008'.

summary.description: Delivery brief: a Thursday pulse blurb or the full Monday Executive Brief, plus the submitter's loss report (dropped fields, unsubmittable entities).

entities.description: May be empty: an empty delivery is a valid 'nothing material' report.

web_url.description: An http(s) URL with a real dotted host. Refuses mailto:, file:, javascript:, bare hosts and whitespace.

name_text.description: Non-blank text in any writing system: at least one character that is not whitespace, a control character or punctuation (ASCII, Latin-1, General Punctuation, CJK and full-width punctuation). Uses a negated class instead of \p{..} so ECMA-262 and Python regex engines agree.

statement.description: Meaningful text in any writing system: at least 4 meaningful characters (as defined for name_text), at least two of them adjacent, so blank, punctuation-only or 'a b c d' strings never pass, while unspaced scripts (Chinese, Japanese) do.

external_id.description: The submitter's stable id for this entity across deliveries (e.g. a Scout entity key). Stored as a strong identifier namespaced by origin, so a re-report with the same id always attaches to the same company even when name or website changed.

related_external_ids.description: Links entities in the same delivery, e.g. a 'person + pre-company opportunity' is sent as two entities that reference each other.

intent.description: What the submitter believes (packet CREATE NOW vs UPDATE). Informational: the resolver decides, and intake never changes an existing candidate's status.

source_scouts.description: Which scouts / lanes found it, e.g. ["Lane 01", "Lane 04"]. Drives yield and convergence audits.

scout_assessment.description: The scout's own assessment, kept verbatim for the operator. Never used as a score.

claims.description: Individual claims with their epistemic label. FACT needs at least one evidence URL.

additionalProperties.description: A real registry id. Placeholders (None, null, N/A, unknown, 0, -, ?) are refused: a registry id is a strong identifier and a shared placeholder would merge unrelated companies.

key_fact.description: The one verifiable fact that makes this worth a look.

confidence.description: Rubric: high = the key_fact is a FACT from a primary source (registry, company, institution, funder); medium = FACT from a secondary source or mixed FACT/INFERENCE; low = mostly INFERENCE/UNKNOWN or a single weak source.

evidence.description: Every claim must be backed by a public web URL. Provisional until the operator verifies it.

material_change.description: Company / opportunity only (decision 0004): a change SINCE the company was rejected that may justify a revisit. evidence_url must be one of this entity's evidence URLs; independent_corroboration needs two independent sources FOR THIS CHANGE: evidence_url plus a supporting_urls entry on another host, or an earlier report of the change (since the rejection, another delivery) whose evidence_url this entity cites, on another host. General company evidence never counts.

supporting_urls.description: Further sources that report THIS change (each one of this entity's evidence URLs).

event.description: Required when kind = event. Give a calendar date (starts_on) when the start time is not evidenced; never invent a time.
